milestones.title: v0.5.0 — CLI & Platform
milestones.description: P4 CLI lifecycle and P5 autostart/supervisor

milestones.title: v0.9.0 — Bridge & Parity
milestones.description: P6 bridge and P7 differential parity

epics.title: P0 — Scaffold & Tracking
epics.label: phase/0-scaffold
epics.body:
## Goal
Stand up the repository: Go module, layout, legal docs, CI, documentation skeleton, and GitHub Project tracking.

## Gate
- [ ] `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `go test -race ./...` green locally
- [ ] CI green on ubuntu/macos/windows
- [ ] GitHub Project populated with all P0–P8 epics and tasks
- [ ] Docs 00–04 and 11 committed

tasks.title: P0.1 — Initialize Go module and repository layout
tasks.body:
## Goal
Create `go.mod` (`github.com/VPpexis/dscodex-go`, go 1.21), the `cmd/dscodex` entry stub, `internal/` package directories, `Makefile`, and `.gitignore`.

## Upstream reference
`package.json` (module metadata).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `go build ./...` succeeds
- [ ] `make build`, `make test`, `make cross` targets defined
- [ ] No generated binaries committed

tasks.title: P0.2 — Legal and agent docs (LICENSE, NOTICE, README, AGENTS.md)
tasks.body:
## Goal
Preserve upstream MIT attribution and document how agents work in this repo.

## Upstream reference
`LICENSE`, `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] LICENSE retains the fish2lab copyright and adds the port copyright
- [ ] NOTICE credits DSCodex v1.1.0
- [ ] AGENTS.md lists build/test commands and the non-negotiable behavior contracts

tasks.title: P0.3 — Documentation skeleton (00–04, 11)
tasks.body:
## Goal
Create the `docs/` directory with overview, architecture, port mapping, parity matrix, implementation plan, and project-tracking documents.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `docs/00-overview.md`, `01-architecture.md`, `02-port-mapping.md`, `03-parity-matrix.md`, `04-implementation-plan.md`, `11-project-tracking.md` exist
- [ ] README links to the docs

tasks.title: P0.4 — CI matrix workflow (gofmt, vet, race tests)
tasks.body:
## Goal
GitHub Actions CI running on ubuntu, macos, and windows with Go 1.21 and stable.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs `gofmt` check, `go vet ./...`, `go test -race ./...`
- [ ] Matrix covers all three OSes
- [ ] Workflow green on the initial commit

tasks.title: P0.5 — Backlog as code and project bootstrap script
tasks.body:
## Goal
Define every epic and task in `scripts/project/issues.json` and apply it with an idempotent `scripts/project/bootstrap.ps1`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `issues.json` covers P0–P8 with fields and acceptance criteria
- [ ] Script creates labels, milestones, epics, tasks, sub-issue links
- [ ] Re-running the script is safe (no duplicate issues)

tasks.title: P0.6 — GitHub Project v2 setup (fields, items, views checklist)
tasks.body:
## Goal
Create the `DSCodex-Go Port Tracker` project, ensure custom fields, add all issues, and set field values. Document the one-time UI steps for views and workflows.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Project exists and is linked to the repository
- [ ] Fields: Phase, Area, Platform, Priority, Size, Est. days, Target
- [ ] All issues are project items with field values set
- [ ] `docs/11-project-tracking.md` documents views and workflows

tasks.title: P0.7 — Issue and PR templates
tasks.body:
## Goal
Add issue forms (epic, task, bug) and a PR template with tracking and platform checklists.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` contains epic, task, bug, and config forms
- [ ] `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` includes `Closes #N` and verification checklist

epics.title: P1 — Foundation
epics.label: phase/1-foundation
epics.body:
## Goal
Port the storage and configuration foundation: constants, keystore, config.toml managed block, catalog, and proxy resolution — with unit tests green on all three OSes.

## Gate
- [ ] `keys`, `config`, `platform`, `proxy-config` suites ported and green
- [ ] Catalog golden fixtures pass
- [ ] DPAPI round-trip verified on Windows CI
- [ ] `go test -race ./...` clean

tasks.title: P1.1 — constants: models, paths, platform helpers
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `constants.mjs`: model table, host/port, `resolveCodexHome`, `pathsFor`, `needsShellSpawn`, version.

## Upstream reference
`src/constants.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Picker slugs and wire models match exactly
- [ ] Paths identical to upstream
- [ ] Unit tests cover `CODEX_HOME` override and Windows shell spawn

tasks.title: P1.2 — keystore: config.json read/write, atomic writes, modes
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port the router config file store: strict/non-strict reads, atomic writes, 0600 mode, empty-file deletion, redaction-safe error messages.

## Upstream reference
`src/keys.mjs` — `readRouterConfig`, `writeRouterConfig`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Corrupt JSON never leaks fragments in errors
- [ ] Temp-file + rename atomic writes
- [ ] Tests use `t.TempDir()`

tasks.title: P1.3 — keystore: DPAPI protect/unprotect on Windows
tasks.body:
## Goal
Implement DPAPI (CurrentUser scope) protect/unprotect for the stored key and proxy URL, replacing the upstream PowerShell call-out.

## Upstream reference
`src/keys.mjs` — `runDpapi`, `dpapiProtect`, `dpapiUnprotect`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Round-trip test on Windows CI
- [ ] `key_encoding`/`proxy_encoding` semantics match (`dpapi` vs `plain`)
- [ ] Non-Windows builds compile without the Windows files

tasks.title: P1.4 — keystore: router token lifecycle and legacy migration
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `createRouterToken`, `readRouterToken`, `writeRouterToken`, `ensureRouterToken`, and the legacy plaintext Windows key migration.

## Upstream reference
`src/keys.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Token regex `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$` enforced on read and write
- [ ] `ensureRouterToken` prefers the config.toml-derived token
- [ ] Legacy migration test on Windows

tasks.title: P1.5 — codexconfig: managed block read/match/rewrite
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port the marker-managed root block: detection, value parsing, token extraction from the URL, match check, and rewrite — preserving the rest of the file line-for-line.

## Upstream reference
`src/config.mjs` — `managedRootBlock`, `readManagedRouterToken`, `managedRouterConfigMatches`, `rewriteManagedRouterConfig`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] CRLF normalized exactly like upstream
- [ ] Only marker-owned root keys are rewritten
- [ ] Golden tests cover messy real-world configs

tasks.title: P1.6 — codexconfig: install/uninstall transforms and desktop reasoning
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `buildInstalledConfig` (strip, conflict check, root injection, `[desktop].enabled-reasoning-efforts`) and `uninstall` behavior.

## Upstream reference
`src/config.mjs` — `stripManagedConfig`, `assertNoRootConflict`, `injectRoot`, `injectDesktopReasoning`, `install`, `uninstall`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] User-owned root keys are never replaced
- [ ] Existing `[desktop]` effort list without `max` errors instead of overwriting
- [ ] Backup file written once before the first install

tasks.title: P1.7 — codexconfig: bridge CODEX_CLI_PATH stripping
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `stripBridgeCliPath` so DSCodex-owned `CODEX_CLI_PATH` values in `[mcp_servers.*.env]` are removed without touching user-owned values.

## Upstream reference
`src/config.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Only owned values removed
- [ ] File not rewritten when nothing changes

tasks.title: P1.8 — catalog: entry build, backfill, identity replacement
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `buildDeepSeekCatalogEntry` and `backfillNativeEntry`: clone from the `gpt-5.6-sol` template, pin DeepSeek fields, replace GPT identity strings, and delete speed-tier fields.

## Upstream reference
`src/catalog.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All pinned fields match upstream exactly
- [ ] Native entries backfilled with required defaults
- [ ] Golden fixture from upstream output matches structurally

tasks.title: P1.9 — catalog: atomic write and sync
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `writeCatalog` and `syncCatalog` with temp-file + rename and 0600 mode.

## Upstream reference
`src/catalog.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Missing cache produces the upstream error message
- [ ] Write is atomic

tasks.title: P1.10 — proxycfg: resolution order, validation, redaction, NO_PROXY
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port proxy resolution (DSCODEX_* first, then standard lowercase-first env, then stored), URL validation, credential redaction, and `NO_PROXY` merging (loopback + api.deepseek.com).

## Upstream reference
`src/proxy-config.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Resolution order matches upstream
- [ ] Redaction hides userinfo, query, and fragment
- [ ] `NO_PROXY` merge is case-insensitive and deduplicated

tasks.title: P1.11 — Port P1 unit suites and golden fixtures
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `keys.test.mjs`, `config.test.mjs`, `platform.test.mjs`, `proxy-config.test.mjs` 1:1 where practical, plus catalog golden tests from upstream output.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Same cases and names as upstream where practical
- [ ] `t.TempDir()` for filesystem tests; real `~/.codex` never touched
- [ ] Green on Windows, macOS, Linux CI

epics.title: P2 — Router Core
epics.label: phase/2-router-core
epics.body:
## Goal
Port the HTTP/SSE router: auth, limits, decoding, header filtering, DeepSeek body transforms, tool replay repair, passthrough, streaming, and shutdown.

## Gate
- [ ] `proxy.test.mjs` parity suite green
- [ ] Streaming, cancel, and limit tests green
- [ ] `go test -race ./...` clean

tasks.title: P2.1 — HTTP server core: timeouts, upgrade 426, limits
tasks.body:
## Goal
Server construction with keep-alive 120 s, headers timeout 125 s, `Upgrade` → 426, and 64 MiB/128 MiB byte caps with 413 responses.

## Upstream reference
`src/proxy.mjs` — `createProxyServer`, `readRequestBody`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Upgrade requests receive 426 without killing the server
- [ ] Oversized bodies return 413 and the connection is drained
- [ ] Timeouts match upstream

tasks.title: P2.2 — Path token auth and control endpoints
tasks.body:
## Goal
Constant-time path token comparison, 404 for misses, `/health`, `/models`, `/v1/models`, and 405 for non-POST API paths.

## Upstream reference
`src/proxy.mjs` — `authorizedPath`, `tokenMatches`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Token compared with constant-time equality
- [ ] Health includes `deepseek_key` and `instance_id`
- [ ] No token → 404 with a generic message

tasks.title: P2.3 — Request body read and content-encoding decode
tasks.body:
## Goal
Read request bodies with limits and decode gzip, deflate (zlib), brotli, and zstd, including decoded-size enforcement.

## Upstream reference
`src/proxy.mjs` — `decodeBody`, `readRequestBody`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All four encodings decode correctly
- [ ] Decompressed cap enforced
- [ ] Unknown encodings produce an error response, not a panic

tasks.title: P2.4 — Upstream client: proxy transport, manual redirects, abort on disconnect
tasks.body:
## Goal
HTTP client with `Transport.Proxy` honoring the resolved proxy, redirects disabled, and context cancellation when the client disconnects.

## Upstream reference
`src/proxy.mjs` — fetch call with `redirect: "manual"` and `AbortController`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Redirects are not followed
- [ ] Client disconnect aborts the upstream request
- [ ] Loopback and api.deepseek.com bypass the proxy

tasks.title: P2.5 — Response header filtering and SSE streaming
tasks.body:
## Goal
Forward response headers minus hop-by-hop, stream the body with per-chunk flush, and log early upstream stream termination.

## Upstream reference
`src/proxy.mjs` — `copyResponseHeaders`, stream pipe.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] SSE events reach the client without buffering delays
- [ ] Hop-by-hop headers stripped
- [ ] Upstream stream errors destroy the client response

tasks.title: P2.6 — Authenticated shutdown endpoint
tasks.body:
## Goal
`POST /<token>/_dscodex/shutdown` with the `x-dscodex-shutdown-token` header, 202 on success, 401 otherwise, invoking the shutdown callback asynchronously.

## Upstream reference
`src/proxy.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Wrong or missing shutdown token → 401
- [ ] Callback runs after the response is sent
- [ ] No PID is ever signalled directly

tasks.title: P2.7 — DeepSeek body transform
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `buildDeepSeekBody`: model rewrite, effort clamp, `store=false`, `parallel_tool_calls=false`, and deletion of unsupported fields.

## Upstream reference
`src/proxy.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Effort clamp exact (`low|medium|high` → `high`, else `max`)
- [ ] All stripped keys verified by tests
- [ ] `json.Number` used to avoid float precision loss

tasks.title: P2.8 — Compaction item conversion in input
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `convertInputItem`: decrypt DSCodex-sealed compaction items into assistant summary messages; drop undecryptable items; strip local `id` fields; map `agent_message` to `message`.

## Upstream reference
`src/proxy.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Foreign compaction items dropped, never forwarded
- [ ] Decrypted summary wrapped as `[Compacted prior context]`

tasks.title: P2.9 — Tool call replay repair (pairing on call_id)
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `normalizeToolCallReplay`: move each tool output directly after its call for `function_call`, `custom_tool_call`, and `local_shell_call`, preserving the relative order of all other items and leaving orphan calls in place.

## Upstream reference
`src/proxy.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Pairing key is `call_id`, never `id`
- [ ] Developer messages inside a pair are moved out
- [ ] Tests cover interleaved and missing outputs

tasks.title: P2.10 — Reasoning cloning for extra calls within a turn
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `reasoningForExtraCalls`: a turn runs from its `reasoning` item through assistant messages and calls, ending at a tool output; every extra call gets a deep copy of the turn's reasoning, never across turn boundaries.

## Upstream reference
`src/proxy.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] First call in a turn is not cloned
- [ ] A turn without its own reasoning inherits nothing
- [ ] Deep copy, not shared reference

tasks.title: P2.11 — Port proxy suite against httptest fakes
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `proxy.test.mjs` cases: routing, auth, header allow-lists, body transforms, passthrough, compaction conversion, and limits.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Upstream fakes replaced with `net/http/httptest`
- [ ] Same case names as upstream where practical
- [ ] Green on all three OSes

tasks.title: P2.12 — Streaming, cancellation, and limit stress tests
tasks.body:
## Goal
Exercise SSE chunk flushing, client disconnect aborting upstream, slow streams, and oversized/decompression-bomb bodies.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Disconnect test asserts upstream cancellation
- [ ] Decoded-size cap test
- [ ] Race detector clean

epics.title: P3 — Vision & Compaction
epics.label: phase/3-vision-compaction
epics.body:
## Goal
Port the GPT vision pipeline and the encrypted compaction handoff, including the synthetic compaction stream.

## Gate
- [ ] `vision.test.mjs` parity suite green
- [ ] Seal/open round-trip and trigger-flow tests green
- [ ] No plaintext compaction summary ever leaves the router

tasks.title: P3.1 — Vision describer with cache and timeout
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `createVisionDescriber`: OAuth identity headers only, `gpt-5.6-sol` default, sha256 LRU (200), 60 s timeout, SSE parsing, empty-description caching.

## Upstream reference
`src/vision.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `DSCODEX_VISION_MODEL` override honored
- [ ] Failures cached as empty strings
- [ ] Concurrent describes per request

tasks.title: P3.2 — Image rewrite integration in the router
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `rewriteImages`: replace `input_image` parts in message content and `function_call_output.output` with GPT text; no-op without `authorization`.

## Upstream reference
`src/vision.mjs`, `src/proxy.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Fallback placeholder text matches upstream
- [ ] Body untouched when no OAuth header
- [ ] Unique images described once per request

tasks.title: P3.3 — Compaction seal/open (AES-256-GCM)
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `sealCompaction`/`openCompaction`: `dscodex-compaction-v1:` prefix, SHA-256(router token) key, `iv(12)|tag(16)|ciphertext` base64url layout.

## Upstream reference
`src/proxy.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Byte-compatible round-trip with upstream seals (differential fixture)
- [ ] Tampered or foreign ciphertext returns null
- [ ] Minimum length check enforced

tasks.title: P3.4 — Compaction trigger flow and synthetic stream
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `isCompactionRequest`, `buildDeepSeekCompactionBody`, and `sendCompactionStream`: strip tools and trigger, append the fixed summary prompt, emit exactly one `compaction` item plus `response.completed`.

## Upstream reference
`src/proxy.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Exactly one synthetic item before completion
- [ ] Usage normalized like upstream
- [ ] Non-compaction DeepSeek requests unaffected

tasks.title: P3.5 — Upstream compaction SSE parsing
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `parseCompactionUpstream` and `textFromMessage`: prefer completed output, then item-done, output-text-done, and delta fallbacks; capture usage.

## Upstream reference
`src/proxy.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All four fallbacks covered by tests
- [ ] `[DONE]` and keep-alives ignored
- [ ] Empty summary produces the upstream error

tasks.title: P3.6 — Vision and compaction tests with fake upstream
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `vision.test.mjs` and add fake-upstream end-to-end tests for the compaction trigger flow.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Cache, timeout, and no-OAuth cases covered
- [ ] Trigger flow asserted end-to-end over HTTP
- [ ] Green on all three OSes

epics.title: P4 — CLI & Lifecycle
epics.label: phase/4-cli-lifecycle
epics.body:
## Goal
Implement every CLI command with upstream-compatible output, exit codes, and the PID-state trust model.

## Gate
- [ ] All commands implemented and covered by tests
- [ ] Manual Windows acceptance: install → start → doctor → stop
- [ ] Key never printed; proxy credentials redacted

tasks.title: P4.1 — CLI dispatch, usage, version, exit codes
tasks.body:
## Goal
stdlib `flag`-based dispatch with subcommands, `--port`/`DSCODEX_PORT`, usage text, `version`, and upstream-compatible exit codes.

## Upstream reference
`src/cli.mjs` — `main`, `usage`, `parsePort`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Unknown command → error + exit 1
- [ ] Help lists every command
- [ ] Version wired to ldflags

tasks.title: P4.2 — install, sync, uninstall commands
tasks.body:
## Goal
Wire `install` (catalog + managed config + token), `sync` (catalog refresh), and `uninstall` (autostart off, stop, strip config, delete owned files).

## Upstream reference
`src/cli.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Install refuses to run over legacy untrusted pid state
- [ ] Uninstall removes only DSCodex-owned state
- [ ] Output messages match upstream intent

tasks.title: P4.3 — key set/status/delete with hidden prompt
tasks.body:
## Goal
Key commands with `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` env override, hidden TTY prompt (`x/term`), stored-key resolution, and restart hints when the router is running.

## Upstream reference
`src/cli.mjs` — `manageKey`, `promptSecret`, `resolveDeepSeekKey`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Key value never echoed or logged
- [ ] Non-TTY without env → clear error
- [ ] Status reports the source (env/stored/launchctl)

tasks.title: P4.4 — proxy set/status/clear
tasks.body:
## Goal
Proxy commands with validation, redacted output, and stored/env source reporting.

## Upstream reference
`src/cli.mjs` — `manageProxy`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Invalid URL rejected with the upstream message
- [ ] Credentials redacted in every output path

tasks.title: P4.5 — PID-state trust model and process liveness
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `readPidState`, `writePidState`, `removePidState` (atomic claim/restore), and platform `processAlive` checks.

## Upstream reference
`src/cli.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Malformed or unauthenticated state refuses to stop anything
- [ ] Replacement-instance state is never clobbered
- [ ] Windows liveness check implemented without signals

tasks.title: P4.6 — serve: foreground server with graceful shutdown
tasks.body:
## Goal
`serve` reconciles the managed binding, resolves the key and proxy, owns the pid file, handles SIGINT/SIGTERM, and exits 0 on authenticated shutdown.

## Upstream reference
`src/cli.mjs` — `serve`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Pid file owned regardless of launcher
- [ ] Graceful close with a 5 s force timer
- [ ] No proxy re-exec (native Go proxy)

tasks.title: P4.7 — start: detached spawn with health wait
tasks.body:
## Goal
`start` spawns a detached `serve`, redirects logs to `server.log`, waits for health, and reports the pid.

## Upstream reference
`src/cli.mjs` — `start`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Already-running detection
- [ ] Detach semantics correct on Windows and POSIX
- [ ] Timeout error points at the log file

tasks.title: P4.8 — stop: authenticated shutdown and stale cleanup
tasks.body:
## Goal
`stop` calls the authenticated shutdown endpoint, polls for exit, removes stale pid state, and never signals an unverified process.

## Upstream reference
`src/cli.mjs` — `stopInstance`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Non-202 responses error without killing
- [ ] Dead pid → stale cleanup
- [ ] 60 × 100 ms exit poll like upstream

tasks.title: P4.9 — status and doctor (six checks)
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `status` and `doctor` with the six checks: config injected, catalog present, router token, proxy running, DeepSeek key in proxy, app-server bridge state.

## Upstream reference
`src/cli.mjs` — `doctor`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Exit 1 when any check fails
- [ ] Bridge check passes trivially off macOS
- [ ] Output format `ok`/`missing` per check

tasks.title: P4.10 — CLI command tests
tasks.body:
## Goal
Test command dispatch, pid-state trust rules, doctor checks, and key/proxy handling with fakes.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] No test touches the real `~/.codex`
- [ ] Trust-model negative cases covered
- [ ] Green on all three OSes

tasks.title: P4.11 — Windows manual acceptance: install → start → doctor → stop
tasks.body:
## Goal
Run the full lifecycle on Windows against a real Codex install and record the result.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `doctor` reports all six checks `ok`
- [ ] Router stops and stays down
- [ ] Codex CLI can list the DeepSeek models from the catalog

epics.title: P5 — Autostart & Supervisor
epics.label: phase/5-autostart-supervisor
epics.body:
## Goal
Port autostart artifact builders and registration for launchd, systemd, and Task Scheduler, plus the Windows supervisor loop.

## Gate
- [ ] Builder golden tests green
- [ ] `autostart enable|disable|status` correct per OS
- [ ] A graceful stop stays down; crashes restart

tasks.title: P5.1 — launchd plist builder
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `buildLaunchdPlist` with `KeepAlive.SuccessfulExit=false` and log paths.

## Upstream reference
`src/autostart.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] XML escaping matches upstream
- [ ] No secrets embedded

tasks.title: P5.2 — systemd unit builder
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `buildSystemdUnit` with `Restart=on-failure` and quoted ExecStart.

## Upstream reference
`src/autostart.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Quoting handles spaces and quotes
- [ ] No secrets embedded

tasks.title: P5.3 — Windows VBS and register script builders
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `buildWindowsVbs`, `encodeWindowsVbs` (UTF-16LE BOM), and `buildWindowsRegisterScript` (interactive principal, restart 255/1 min, hidden wscript).

## Upstream reference
`src/autostart.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `%USERPROFILE%` expansion for non-ASCII paths
- [ ] Task settings match upstream
- [ ] No secrets embedded

tasks.title: P5.4 — autostart enable/disable/status with rollback
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port registration and rollback semantics: register before replacing a healthy manual router, restore it on failure, and keep `stop` authoritative.

## Upstream reference
`src/cli.mjs` — `autostartEnable`, `autostartDisable`, `autostartStatus`, `restoreManualRouter`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Failed handoff restores the manual router
- [ ] Status warns when the router runs manually under an inactive task
- [ ] Disable removes generated artifacts

tasks.title: P5.5 — Supervisor crash-restart loop
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `superviseRouter`: log ownership, 2 s restart delay, exit 0 stays down, spawn failures retried.

## Upstream reference
`src/supervisor.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Clean exit stops the loop
- [ ] Nonzero exit restarts
- [ ] Supervisor log lines timestamped

tasks.title: P5.6 — Autostart builder golden tests
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `autostart.test.mjs` builder cases and supervisor tests.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Plist/unit/VBS outputs match golden fixtures
- [ ] Path escaping cases covered
- [ ] Green on all three OSes

tasks.title: P5.7 — Windows Task Scheduler smoke
tasks.body:
## Goal
Register, run, verify, and remove the scheduled task on Windows.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Task starts a live supervisor (state Running)
- [ ] `stop` leaves it down until next logon/run
- [ ] Disable removes the task and VBS

epics.title: P6 — App-Server Bridge
epics.label: phase/6-bridge
epics.body:
## Goal
Port the opt-in macOS app-server bridge: stock Codex resolution, JSONL rewrite, provider/effort memory, and launchctl wiring.

## Gate
- [ ] State and picker smoke equivalents pass on macOS
- [ ] Non-macOS platforms unaffected (bridge command reports unavailable)
- [ ] Non-matching JSONL passes through byte-for-byte

tasks.title: P6.1 — Stock Codex resolution chain
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `resolveRealCodex`: launchctl getenv, env, bundled ChatGPT app binary, PATH; never resolve to the wrapper itself.

## Upstream reference
`src/real-codex.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Fallback order exact
- [ ] Unit tests with injected fakes

tasks.title: P6.2 — Wrapper spawn, stdio passthrough, signal forwarding
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `codex-wrapper.mjs` non-app-server behavior: delete `CODEX_CLI_PATH`, pipe stdio, forward SIGINT/SIGTERM, propagate exit codes.

## Upstream reference
`src/codex-wrapper.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Child environment cleaned
- [ ] Exit code/signal propagation correct

tasks.title: P6.3 — App-server JSONL rewrite loop
tasks.body:
## Goal
Read client/server JSONL lines, rewrite via the state machine, and pass through unparseable or untracked lines unchanged. Handle long lines (no 64 KB scanner limit).

## Upstream reference
`src/codex-wrapper.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Multi-megabyte lines handled
- [ ] Invalid JSON passed through unchanged

tasks.title: P6.4 — State machine: load/save/reconcile, thread cap
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `createAppServerState`: versioned state, per-provider effort slots, OpenAI service tier, bounded thread map (500), atomic writes, and `reconcileWithConfig`.

## Upstream reference
`src/app-server-state.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Effort normalization exact (`high` stays, else `max` for DeepSeek)
- [ ] Corrupt state falls back to initial state
- [ ] Reconciliation adopts live config provider/effort/tier

tasks.title: P6.5 — Provider/effort switching and staleEffort
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port the rewrite handlers: `config/batchWrite`, `config/value/write`, `thread/start`, `thread/resume`, `thread/fork`, `thread/settings/update`, and server-response reconciliation, including `staleEffort`.

## Upstream reference
`src/app-server-state.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Cross-provider switch restores the saved slot
- [ ] Model-only write sets `staleEffort`
- [ ] Threads unseen by the bridge default to the last active provider

tasks.title: P6.6 — Bridge shim and launchctl enable/disable/status
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port shim generation and the `bridge` command: refuse user-owned `CODEX_CLI_PATH`, set `DSCODEX_REAL_CODEX` and `CODEX_CLI_PATH`, and strip owned values on disable.

## Upstream reference
`src/cli.mjs` — `manageBridge`, `activateBridge`, `deactivateBridge`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] User-owned CODEX_CLI_PATH refused
- [ ] Disable clears launchctl values and config snapshots

tasks.title: P6.7 — State and picker smoke equivalents
tasks.body:
## Goal
Port `state-smoke.mjs` and `picker-smoke.mjs` to Go scripts that exercise a real Codex app-server through the wrapper.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] DeepSeek→GPT effort/tier round trip asserted
- [ ] Model list shows both DeepSeek entries with `high|max` efforts
- [ ] Skips cleanly when Codex is not installed

epics.title: P7 — Parity & Differential Validation
epics.label: phase/7-parity
epics.body:
## Goal
Prove parity: differential fixtures from upstream Node, remaining suites, race/stress passes, and real end-to-end tool loops.

## Gate
- [ ] Every row in `docs/03-parity-matrix.md` verified
- [ ] Real Codex CLI tool loop works for both DeepSeek models
- [ ] GPT passthrough regression green

tasks.title: P7.1 — Node differential fixture generator
tasks.body:
## Goal
Scripts that run the upstream Node implementation to emit golden fixtures: catalog, config transforms, DeepSeek bodies, compaction seal/open, vision SSE.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Fixtures checked into `testdata/`
- [ ] Go tests assert parsed-structure equality
- [ ] Regeneration documented

tasks.title: P7.2 — Port remaining unit suites
tasks.body:
## Goal
Close any gaps against the upstream test list in `docs/03-parity-matrix.md`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Every upstream suite has a Go counterpart
- [ ] No skipped tests without a documented reason

tasks.title: P7.3 — Race and stress pass
tasks.body:
## Goal
Run `go test -race ./...` plus concurrent request, cache, and state-machine stress tests.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] No races on any OS
- [ ] Vision cache and state writes safe under concurrency

tasks.title: P7.4 — Real tool loop: deepseek-v4-flash
tasks.body:
## Goal
Run the upstream acceptance command with the Go router serving.

## Command
`codex -m deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash -c 'model_reasoning_effort="max"' -a never exec --skip-git-repo-check 'call a shell tool exactly once ...'`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Tool call executes and the turn completes
- [ ] No replay errors on the next turn

tasks.title: P7.5 — Real tool loop: deepseek-v4-pro
tasks.body:
## Goal
Same acceptance loop for `deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Tool call executes and the turn completes
- [ ] Effort reports `max`

tasks.title: P7.6 — GPT passthrough regression
tasks.body:
## Goal
Verify GPT-bound traffic is forwarded untouched with OAuth headers intact and no DeepSeek transforms applied.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Body byte-identical for a passthrough request
- [ ] OAuth header set forwarded

tasks.title: P7.7 — macOS picker and bridge smoke
tasks.body:
## Goal
Run the picker and state smokes against the desktop app catalog on macOS.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `🐳 V4 Flash` and `🐳 V4 Pro` visible with `high|max` efforts
- [ ] Native GPT entries preserved

tasks.title: P7.8 — Parity matrix completion and docs sweep
tasks.body:
## Goal
Update `03-parity-matrix.md` with verified results, document all intentional differences, and create `docs/10-upstream-sync.md`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Every matrix row marked verified
- [ ] Upstream sync process documented

epics.title: P8 — Release
epics.label: phase/8-release
epics.body:
## Goal
Ship v1.0.0: cross-compiled binaries, checksums, release automation, and install documentation.

## Gate
- [ ] Release candidate installs and passes `doctor` on all three OSes
- [ ] Checksums published
- [ ] Docs complete

tasks.title: P8.1 — goreleaser config and version ldflags
tasks.body:
## Goal
Add `.goreleaser.yml` building darwin/linux/windows × amd64/arm64 with `main.version` ldflags and checksums.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `goreleaser build --snapshot` succeeds
- [ ] Archives named consistently
- [ ] Checksums generated

tasks.title: P8.2 — Tag-triggered release workflow
tasks.body:
## Goal
GitHub Actions workflow running goreleaser on `v*` tags with `GITHUB_TOKEN`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Tag push produces a draft release
- [ ] Binaries attached with checksums

tasks.title: P8.3 — Install documentation and checksums
tasks.body:
## Goal
Document install, upgrade from Node DSCodex, autostart, and uninstall with checksum verification.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] README quick start works from a clean machine
- [ ] Migration notes cover drop-in state reuse

tasks.title: P8.4 — v1.0.0 release candidate verification
tasks.body:
## Goal
Install the release candidate on each OS, run `doctor`, and execute one tool loop per DeepSeek model.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Six doctor checks `ok` on Windows, macOS, Linux
- [ ] Both models complete a tool loop
- [ ] GPT passthrough still works
